question: Who has most partnership runs in a World Cup?
query: SELECT T2.player_name, T3.player_name, SUM(T1.runs_scored + T1.extra_runs) AS runs FROM Deliveries AS T1 JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id JOIN Players AS T3 ON T1.non_striker_id = T3.player_id JOIN Matches AS T4 ON T1.match_id = T4.match_id GROUP BY T4.season, T1.striker_id, T1.non_striker_id ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Who has most partnership runs in a World Cup?
question_punjabi: ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਾਂਝੇਦਾਰੀ ਰਨ ਕਿਸ ਦੇ ਹਨ?
question_telugu: ఎవరి దగ్గర వరల్డ్ కప్పులో అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ భాగస్వామ్య పరుగులు ఉన్నాయి?

question: List most wickets taken by bowlers of a team in a single World Cup Edition.
query: SELECT T1.bowling_team, T2.season, COUNT(*) AS wickets FROM Deliveries AS T1 JOIN Matches AS T2 ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id WHERE T1.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND T1.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt') GROUP BY T1.bowling_team, T2.season ORDER BY wickets DESC LIMIT 3;
question_english: List most wickets taken by bowlers of a team in a single World Cup Edition.
question_punjabi: ਇੱਕ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸੇ ਟੀਮ ਦੇ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਲਈਆਂ ਗਈਆਂ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ।
question_telugu: ఒక వరల్డ్ కప్పు ఎడిషన్లో ఒక టీం యొక్క బౌలర్లు తీసిన అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ విక్కెట్ల జాబితా ఏమిటి?

question: Which teams had their only defeat in a World Cup edition coming in the final?
query: SELECT T1.season, CASE WHEN T1.match_winner = T1.team1 THEN T1.team2 ELSE T1.team1 END AS runner_up FROM Matches AS T1 WHERE T1.stage = 'Final' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Matches AS T2 WHERE T2.season = T1.season AND (T2.team1 = (CASE WHEN T1.match_winner = T1.team1 THEN T1.team2 ELSE T1.team1 END) OR T2.team2 = (CASE WHEN T1.match_winner = T1.team1 THEN T1.team2 ELSE T1.team1 END)) AND T2.match_winner != (CASE WHEN T1.match_winner = T1.team1 THEN T1.team2 ELSE T1.team1 END)) = 1;
question_english: Which teams had their only defeat in a World Cup edition coming in the final?
question_punjabi: ਕਿਹੜੀਆਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਦੀ ਕਿਸੇ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਕਲੌਤੀ ਹਾਰ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਫਾਈਨਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੋਈ ਸੀ?
question_telugu: ఒక వరల్డ్ కప్పు ఎడిషన్లో ఒకే ఓటమి ఫైనల్లోనే వచ్చిన టీం ఏమిటి?

question: Who has most wickets in a single edition of the World Cup?
query: SELECT P.player_name, M.season, COUNT(*) AS wickets FROM Deliveries AS D JOIN Matches AS M ON D.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players AS P ON D.bowler_id = P.player_id WHERE D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt') GROUP BY P.player_name, M.season ORDER BY wickets DESC LIMIT 5;
question_english: Who has most wickets in a single edition of the World Cup?
question_punjabi: ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਦੇ ਇੱਕ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਕਿਸ ਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ?
question_telugu: ఒక వరల్డ్ కప్పు ఎడిషన్లో ఎవరికి అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ వికెట్లు ఉన్నాయి?

question: Who won the Player of the Match in semifinal and final of a World Cup?
query: SELECT P.player_name, M.season FROM Matches AS M JOIN Players AS P ON M.player_of_match_id = P.player_id WHERE M.stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final') GROUP BY P.player_name, M.season HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT M.stage) = 2;
question_english: Who won the Player of the Match in semifinal and final of a World Cup?
question_punjabi: ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਦੇ ਸੈਮੀਫਾਈਨਲ ਅਤੇ ਫਾਈਨਲ ਦੋਵਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ 'ਪਲੇਅਰ ਆਫ਼ ਦ ਮੈਚ' ਕੌਣ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ?
question_telugu: ఒక వరల్డ్ కప్పులో ఎవరు సెమీఫైనల్ మరియు ఫైనల్లో ప్లేయర్ ఆఫ్ తే మ్యాచ్ గెలిచారు?

question: Who has the highest partnerships in World Cup finals?
query: SELECT T2.player_name, T3.player_name, SUM(T1.runs_scored + T1.extra_runs) AS runs FROM Deliveries AS T1 JOIN Players AS T2 ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id JOIN Players AS T3 ON T1.non_striker_id = T3.player_id JOIN Matches AS T4 ON T1.match_id = T4.match_id WHERE T4.stage = 'Final' GROUP BY T1.match_id, T1.striker_id, T1.non_striker_id ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 3;
question_english: Who has the highest partnerships in World Cup finals?
question_punjabi: ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਦੇ ਫਾਈਨਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡੀ ਸਾਂਝੇਦਾਰੀ ਕਿਸ ਦੀ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ?
question_telugu: వరల్డ్ కప్పు ఫైనల్సలో ఎవరికి అన్నిటికన్నా పెద్ద భాగస్వామ్యం ఉన్నది?

question: What are the lowest win-margins in World Cup knockouts (by wickets)?
query: SELECT match_winner, result_margin, team1, team2, season, stage FROM Matches WHERE stage NOT LIKE '%Group%' AND stage NOT LIKE '%League%' AND result_type = 'wickets' ORDER BY result_margin ASC LIMIT 3;
question_english: What are the lowest win-margins in World Cup knockouts (by wickets)?
question_punjabi: ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਦੇ ਨਾਕਆਊਟ ਮੈਚਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਦੇ ਲਿਹਾਜ਼ ਨਾਲ ਜਿੱਤ ਦੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਘੱਟ ਅੰਤਰ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਹਨ?
question_telugu: వరల్డ్ కప్పు నౌక్అవుట్సలో అన్నితకన్న తక్కువ గెలుపు అంచులు ఏమిటి? (విక్కెట్ల ద్వారా)

question: Which team has most defeats in World Cup semi-finals?
query: SELECT CASE WHEN match_winner = team1 THEN team2 ELSE team1 END AS loser, COUNT(*) AS defeats FROM Matches WHERE stage LIKE 'Semi Final%' GROUP BY loser ORDER BY defeats DESC LIMIT 4;
question_english: Which team has most defeats in World Cup semi-finals?
question_punjabi: ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਦੇ ਸੈਮੀਫਾਈਨਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਹਾਰਾਂ ਕਿਸ ਟੀਮ ਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ?
question_telugu: వరల్డ్ కప్పు సెమీఫైనల్స్లో ఏ టీం అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ సార్లు ఓడిపోయింది?

question: Which teams have most wins in a single World Cup edition?
query: SELECT match_winner, season, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM Matches WHERE match_winner IS NOT NULL GROUP BY match_winner, season ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 5;
question_english: Which teams have most wins in a single World Cup edition?
question_punjabi: ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਦੇ ਇੱਕ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਜਿੱਤਾਂ ਕਿਸ ਟੀਮ ਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ?
question_telugu: ఒక వరల్డ్ కప్పు ఎడిషన్లో ఏ టిములు అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ సార్లు గెలిచారు?

question: Give stats of AUS vs SA in ODIs since 2016?
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = 'South Africa' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sa_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = 'Australia' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aus_wins FROM Matches WHERE ((team1 = 'Australia' AND team2 = 'South Africa') OR (team1 = 'South Africa' AND team2 = 'Australia')) AND match_date > '2016-01-01';
question_english: Give stats of AUS vs SA in ODIs since 2016?
question_punjabi: 2016 ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ODI ਮੈਚਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ Australia vs South Africa ਦੇ ਅੰਕੜੇ ਦੱਸੋ।
question_telugu: 2016 నుంచి ODIల లో ఆస్ట్రేలియా సౌత్ ఆఫ్రికా కి వ్యతిరేకంగా ఆడిన మ్యాచుల గణాంకాలు ఏమిటి?

question: Which teams have qualified for the World Cup finals most often?
query: SELECT Team, COUNT(*) AS appearances FROM (SELECT team1 AS Team FROM Matches WHERE stage = 'Final' UNION ALL SELECT team2 AS Team FROM Matches WHERE stage = 'Final') GROUP BY Team ORDER BY appearances DESC LIMIT 5;
question_english: Which teams have qualified for the World Cup finals most often?
question_punjabi: ਕਿਹੜੀਆਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਨੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਵਾਰ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਦੇ ਫਾਈਨਲ ਲਈ ਕੁਆਲੀਫਾਈ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ?
question_telugu: ఏ టిములు అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ సార్లు వరల్డ్ కప్పు ఫినల్స్ కి చేరారు?

question: Who has the most wickets in a World Cup edition for South Africa?
query: SELECT P.player_name, M.season, COUNT(*) AS wickets FROM Deliveries AS D JOIN Matches AS M ON D.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players AS P ON D.bowler_id = P.player_id WHERE D.bowling_team = 'South Africa' AND D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt') GROUP BY P.player_name, M.season ORDER BY wickets DESC LIMIT 4;
question_english: Who has the most wickets in a World Cup edition for South Africa?
question_punjabi: South Africa ਲਈ ਇੱਕ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਕਿਸ ਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ?
question_telugu: ఒక వరల్డ్ కప్పు ఎడిషన్లో సౌత్ ఆఫ్రికా తరపన ఎవరికి అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ వికెట్లు ఉన్నాయి?

question: Who has most wicketkeeping dismissals in a World Cup edition?
query: SELECT P.player_name, M.season, COUNT(*) AS dismissals FROM FielderDismissals AS F JOIN Deliveries AS D ON F.delivery_id = D.delivery_id JOIN Matches AS M ON D.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players AS P ON F.fielder_id = P.player_id WHERE D.wicket_type IN ('caught', 'stumped') GROUP BY P.player_name, M.season ORDER BY dismissals DESC LIMIT 4;
question_english: Who has most wicketkeeping dismissals in a World Cup edition?
question_punjabi: ਇੱਕ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਕਟਕੀਪਰ ਵਜੋਂ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਕਿਸ ਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ?
question_telugu: ఒక వరల్డ్ కప్పు ఎడిషన్లో ఎవరికి అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ వికెట్కీపర్ ద్వారా జరిగిన అవుట్లు ఉన్నాయి?

question: Who has the highest bowling average in ODIs against any opponent?
query: SELECT P.player_name, D.batting_team AS opponent, CAST(SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(D.player_out_id) AS average FROM Deliveries AS D JOIN Players AS P ON D.bowler_id = P.player_id WHERE D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY P.player_name, opponent HAVING COUNT(D.player_out_id) > 10 ORDER BY average DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Who has the highest bowling average in ODIs against any opponent?
question_punjabi: ODI ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸੇ ਵੀ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਦੇ ਖਿਲਾਫ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਔਸਤ ਕਿਸਦੀ ਹੈ?
question_telugu: ODIల లో ఎవరికి అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ బౌలింగ్ ఆవెరేజ్ ఉన్నది?

question: Who has the lowest average in ODIs as a bowler between Australia and South Africa?
query: SELECT P.player_name, CAST(SUM(D.runs_scored) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS average FROM Deliveries AS D JOIN Matches AS M ON D.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players AS P ON D.bowler_id = P.player_id WHERE ((M.team1 = 'Australia' AND M.team2 = 'South Africa') OR (M.team1 = 'South Africa' AND M.team2 = 'Australia')) GROUP BY P.player_name HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) > 5 ORDER BY average ASC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Who has the lowest average in ODIs as a bowler between Australia and South Africa?
question_punjabi: ਆਸਟ੍ਰੇਲੀਆ ਅਤੇ ਦੱਖਣੀ ਅਫ਼ਰੀਕਾ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ODI ਮੈਚਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ ਵਜੋਂ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਘੱਟ ਔਸਤ ਕਿਸਦੀ ਹੈ?
question_telugu: ODIల లో ఆస్ట్రేలియా సౌత్ ఆఫ్రికా కి వ్యతిరేకంగా ఆడిన మ్యాచులలో ఆడిన బౌలర్లలో ఎవరికి అన్నిటికన్నా తక్కువ ఆవెరేజ్ ఉన్నది?

question: Who has hit Hundreds for SA in ICC ODI tournament knockouts?
query: SELECT P.player_name, M.stage, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS score FROM Deliveries AS D JOIN Matches AS M ON D.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players AS P ON D.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE D.batting_team = 'South Africa' AND M.stage NOT LIKE '%Group%' AND M.stage NOT LIKE '%League%' GROUP BY D.match_id, P.player_name HAVING score >= 100;
question_english: Who has hit Hundreds for SA in ICC ODI tournament knockouts?
question_punjabi: ICC ODI ਟੂਰਨਾਮੈਂਟ ਦੇ ਨਾਕਆਊਟ ਮੈਚਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੱਖਣੀ ਅਫ਼ਰੀਕਾ ਲਈ ਸੈਂਕੜੇ ਕਿਸਨੇ ਮਾਰੇ ਹਨ?
question_telugu: ODI టోర్నమెంట్ నొక్ఔట్లలో సౌత్ ఆఫ్రికా తరపన ఎవరు శతకాలు కొట్టారు?

question: List Most ODI hundreds from No.5 or below.
query: SELECT P.player_name, COUNT(*) AS hundreds FROM (SELECT match_id, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, batting_team ORDER BY MIN(delivery_id)) AS batting_pos FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, striker_id) AS Stats JOIN Players AS P ON Stats.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE Stats.runs >= 100 AND Stats.batting_pos >= 5 GROUP BY P.player_name ORDER BY hundreds DESC LIMIT 5;
question_english: List Most ODI hundreds from No.5 or below.
question_punjabi: ਨੰਬਰ 5 ਜਾਂ ਉਸ ਤੋਂ ਹੇਠਾਂ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋਏ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ODI ਸੈਂਕੜਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ।
question_telugu: నెంబర్ 5 లేదా దానికన్నా కింద ఉన్న ఏ క్రీడాకార్లు అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ శతకాలు కొట్టారు?

question: List Most ODI hundreds against a team from No. 5 or below.
query: SELECT P.player_name, Opponent.bowling_team, COUNT(*) AS hundreds FROM (SELECT match_id, striker_id, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, batting_team ORDER BY MIN(delivery_id)) AS batting_pos FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, striker_id) AS Stats JOIN Players AS P ON Stats.striker_id = P.player_id JOIN Deliveries AS Opponent ON Stats.match_id = Opponent.match_id WHERE Stats.runs >= 100 AND Stats.batting_pos >= 5 GROUP BY P.player_name, Opponent.bowling_team ORDER BY hundreds DESC LIMIT 3;
question_english: List Most ODI hundreds against a team from No. 5 or below.
question_punjabi: ਕਿਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਟੀਮ ਦੇ ਖਿਲਾਫ ਨੰਬਰ 5 ਜਾਂ ਉਸ ਤੋਂ ਹੇਠਾਂ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋਏ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ODI ਸੈਂਕੜਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ।
question_telugu: నెంబర్ 5 లేదా దానికన్నా కింద ఉన్న ఏ క్రీడాకార్లు ఒక టీం కి వ్యతిరేకంగా అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ శతకాలు కొట్టారు?

question: Who has most ODI sixes for South Africa?
query: SELECT P.player_name, COUNT(*) AS sixes FROM Deliveries AS D JOIN Players AS P ON D.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE D.batting_team = 'South Africa' AND D.runs_scored = 6 GROUP BY P.player_name ORDER BY sixes DESC LIMIT 5;
question_english: Who has most ODI sixes for South Africa?
question_punjabi: South Africa ਲਈ ODI ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਛੱਕੇ ਕਿਸਦੇ ਹਨ?
question_telugu: సౌత్ ఆఫ్రికా కి తరపన ఎవరు అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ సిక్సులు కొట్టారు?

question: List the Highest individual scores for SA in World Cup knockouts.
query: SELECT P.player_name, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS score, M.stage, M.season FROM Deliveries AS D JOIN Matches AS M ON D.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players AS P ON D.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE D.batting_team = 'South Africa' AND M.stage NOT LIKE '%Group%' GROUP BY D.match_id, P.player_name ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 3;
question_english: List the Highest individual scores for SA in World Cup knockouts.
question_punjabi: ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਦੇ ਨਾਕਆਊਟ ਮੈਚਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ South Africa ਲਈ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡੇ ਵਿਅਕਤੀਗਤ ਸਕੋਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ।
question_telugu: వరల్డ్ కప్పు నొక్ఔట్లలో సౌత్ ఆఫ్రికా కి తరపన అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ స్కోర్లు ఏమిటి?

question: List Most sixes hit in a World Cup match.
query: SELECT M.team1, M.team2, M.season, COUNT(*) AS sixes FROM Deliveries AS D JOIN Matches AS M ON D.match_id = M.match_id WHERE D.runs_scored = 6 GROUP BY M.match_id ORDER BY sixes DESC LIMIT 4;
question_english: List Most sixes hit in a World Cup match.
question_punjabi: ਇੱਕ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਮੈਚ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਾਰੇ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਛੱਕਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ।
question_telugu: ఒక వరల్డ్ కప్పు మ్యాచ్లో అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ సిక్సులు ఏమిటి?

question: What are the highest aggregates in a World Cup match?
query: SELECT M.team1, M.team2, M.season, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS aggregate_score FROM Deliveries AS D JOIN Matches AS M ON D.match_id = M.match_id GROUP BY M.match_id ORDER BY aggregate_score DESC LIMIT 3;
question_english: What are the highest aggregates in a World Cup match?
question_punjabi: ਇੱਕ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਮੈਚ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਕੁੱਲ ਰਨ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਹਨ?
question_telugu: ఒక వరల్డ్ కప్పు మ్యాచ్లో అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ సముదాయాలు ఏమిటి?

question: List the players having Most runs in a World Cup edition for New Zealand.
query: SELECT P.player_name, M.season, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries AS D JOIN Matches AS M ON D.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players AS P ON D.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE D.batting_team = 'New Zealand' GROUP BY P.player_name, M.season ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 3;
question_english: List the players having Most runs in a World Cup edition for New Zealand.
question_punjabi: New Zealand ਲਈ ਇੱਕ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਨ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ।
question_telugu: ఒక వరల్డ్ కప్పు ఎడిషన్లో న్యూ జిలెండ్ తరపన ఎవరికి అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ పరుగులు ఉన్నాయి?

question: List the players having most sixes in a World Cup edition.
query: SELECT P.player_name, M.season, COUNT(*) AS sixes FROM Deliveries AS D JOIN Matches AS M ON D.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players AS P ON D.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE D.runs_scored = 6 GROUP BY P.player_name, M.season ORDER BY sixes DESC LIMIT 3;
question_english: List the players having most sixes in a World Cup edition.
question_punjabi: ਇੱਕ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਛੱਕੇ ਮਾਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ।
question_telugu: ఒక వరల్డ్ కప్పు ఎడిషన్లో ఏ క్రీడాకార్లుకి అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ ఆరులు ఉన్నాయి?

question: List the best bowling returns for India in ODIs.
query: SELECT P.player_name, COUNT(D.player_out_id) AS wickets, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS runs_conceded FROM Deliveries AS D JOIN Matches AS M ON D.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players AS P ON D.bowler_id = P.player_id WHERE D.bowling_team = 'India' AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt') GROUP BY D.match_id, P.player_name ORDER BY wickets DESC, runs_conceded ASC LIMIT 2;
question_english: List the best bowling returns for India in ODIs.
question_punjabi: ODI ਵਿੱਚ India ਲਈ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਪ੍ਰਦਰਸ਼ਨ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ।
question_telugu: ODIల లో ఇండియా తరపన అత్యుత్తమ బౌలింగ్ రిటర్న్‌లు ఏమిటి?

question: Who has two (or more) World Cup five-fors against an opponent?
query: SELECT P.player_name, D.batting_team AS opponent, COUNT(*) AS five_fors FROM (SELECT match_id, bowler_id, batting_team, COUNT(player_out_id) AS wkts FROM Deliveries WHERE wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt') GROUP BY match_id, bowler_id) AS Innings JOIN Players AS P ON Innings.bowler_id = P.player_id WHERE wkts >= 5 GROUP BY P.player_name, opponent HAVING five_fors >= 2;
question_english: Who has two (or more) World Cup five-fors against an opponent?
question_punjabi: ਕਿਸੇ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਦੇ ਖਿਲਾਫ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੋ ਜਾਂ ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਵਾਰ ਪੰਜ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਲੈਣ ਦਾ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਕਿਸਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਹੈ?
question_telugu: వరల్డ్ కప్పులో ఏ క్రీడాకార్లుకి ఒక టీం కి వ్యతిరేకంగా 2 లేదా దానికన్నా ఎక్కువ ఫైవ్-ఫోర్లు ఉన్నాయి?

question: List the players having most wickets in a single World Cup edition.
query: SELECT P.player_name, M.season, COUNT(*) AS wickets FROM Deliveries AS D JOIN Matches AS M ON D.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players AS P ON D.bowler_id = P.player_id WHERE D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt') GROUP BY P.player_name, M.season ORDER BY wickets DESC LIMIT 3;
question_english: List the players having most wickets in a single World Cup edition.
question_punjabi: ਇੱਕ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਲੈਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ।
question_telugu: ఒక వరల్డ్ కప్పు ఎడిషన్లో ఏ క్రీడాకార్లుకి అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ వికెట్లు ఉన్నాయి?

question: List players having most five-fors in World Cups.
query: SELECT P.player_name, COUNT(*) AS five_fors FROM (SELECT match_id, bowler_id, COUNT(player_out_id) AS wkts FROM Deliveries WHERE wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt') GROUP BY match_id, bowler_id HAVING wkts >= 5) AS Innings JOIN Players AS P ON Innings.bowler_id = P.player_id GROUP BY P.player_name ORDER BY five_fors DESC LIMIT 2;
question_english: List players having most five-fors in World Cups.
question_punjabi: ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਵਾਰ ਪੰਜ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਲੈਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਿਓ।
question_telugu: వరల్డ్ కప్పులో ఏ క్రీడాకార్లుకి అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ ఫైవ్-ఫోర్లు ఉన్నాయి?
